Find below a list of my publications, their DOI, and a PDF copy of the manuscript.

```{r pubs, results="asis"}
# packages
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# read data file and transform
papers <- as_tibble(readxl::read_excel("data/papers.xlsx")) %>% 
  filter(logical) %>% 
  mutate(
    authors = gsub("Rodrigo R. Granjel", "<u>Rodrigo R. Granjel</u>", authors)  # Highlight your name
  )

# Function to create a table for each status category
create_table <- function(status) {
  filtered_papers <- papers %>%
    filter(status == !!status) %>%
    arrange(-index)

  if (nrow(filtered_papers) > 0) {
    content <- filtered_papers %>%
      mutate(
        content = paste0(
          "<div class='paper-entry'>",
            "<div class='title'><strong>", title, "</strong></div>",
            "<div class='authors'>", authors, "</div>",
            "<div class='journal-year'>", journal, ", ", year, "</div>",
            "<div class='buttons'>",
              "<a href='", doi, "' class='button'>DOI</a>",
              " <a href='", ifelse(!is.na(pdf), file.path("docs/papers", pdf), "#"), "' class='button'>", 
              ifelse(!is.na(pdf), "PDF", "No PDF Available"), "</a>",
            "</div>",
          "</div>"
        )
      ) %>%
      pull(content)  # Extract the HTML content as a character vector

    # Wrap the content in a container to apply alternating row colors
    cat(paste("<h3>", stringr::str_to_title(status), "Papers</h3>"))  # Header for the status
    cat("<div class='papers-table'>")  # Start table-like container
    for (i in seq_along(content)) {
      # Apply alternating background colors using CSS classes
      if (i %% 2 == 0) {
        cat("<div class='paper-row even'>", content[i], "</div>")
      } else {
        cat("<div class='paper-row odd'>", content[i], "</div>")
      }
    }
    cat("</div>")  # End table-like container
  }
}

# Display tables for each status
create_table("submitted")
create_table("preprint")
create_table("published")
```

Additionally, I am one of the >1,500 co-signatories on [this paper](https://doi.org/10.1093/biosci/biae043).
